packages.name: libfuzzer-sys
packages.note: Cargo metadata declares (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND NCSA, while the bundled libfuzzer source headers declare Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception. LICENSE-LLVM.txt preserves the LLVM Apache license, exception, and historical NCSA/MIT notices; CREDITS-LLVM.txt supplies the referenced attribution. These are from LLVM commit a47b42eb9f9b302167b4fc413e6c92798d65dd0b, recorded in update-libfuzzer.sh at the crate source commit. The SHA-1 source notice also preserves its public-domain attribution.
